jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About Middesk Engineering:

We believe "velocity" is the rate at which we effect realized value for our customers, not the rate at which we ship code. And this pushes us to center our work around customers; how will this change I'm about to make help our customers get jobs done? 

When we’re coding, we're making hundreds of micro-decisions about user experience that add up. How can I communicate this exception to our customers in a manner that helps them understand what's happened and unblock themselves?

 

About The Role:

Engineers have the freedom to create a lot of impact for our customers. The role requires high agency and comfort with change. It requires people who believe the interesting problems in Engineering are stack-agnostic. It requires Engineers who believe that solving customer problems quickly is what matters first; building scalable systems matters when customer problems are scaling problems.

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2 days per week in our SF or NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What You'll Do:

  • Work in React, Redux, Ruby, Rails, Postgres, and potentially Python, and Go to solve problems for our customers.

  • Dive into all layers of the stack; frontend, backend, API, data processors, etc.

  • Jam with Product Managers, Designers, Ops, and other Engineers every day to shape the direction of our products. 

  • Share your knowledge with others in Engineering; people should get better at their craft because they work with you. Even if you’re early in your career, you have something to teach. 

  • Contribute to the psychological safety of your team. Software is built by groups of people, and good relationships matter.

  • Help us interview and hire other Engineers.

What We’re Looking For:

  • While we agree the interesting problems in Engineering are stack-agnostic, we’d love it if you had experience with a couple of the languages in our stack (see the first point above). We’ve found that Engineers with prior stack experience usually ramp faster.

  • You’ve worked for a high-growth, venture-backed startup before and are looking for a similar role. Or, you've founded a company and are looking to get back into it.

  • You’ve been working as a professional Software Engineer for at least three or more years.

  • You understand SaaS business fundamentals (e.g. annual contract value, customer acquisition cost, and annual-recurring revenue) and can demonstrate how the work you’ve done influences these metrics.

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About The Role:

As one of the members of Middesk’s Account Management team, you will own and nurture long-term relationships with our earliest and highest-potential customers. Your focus will be on driving customer success by identifying opportunities to expand adoption, improve business outcomes, and maximize the value customers get from Middesk’s products.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor, advocating for customer needs internally and collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop win-win solutions. Through regular touchpoints and business reviews, you’ll help customers understand their realized value while identifying ways to deepen engagement.

This role sits at the intersection of technical expertise, product knowledge, and industry insight, working closely with our go-to-market, operations, and product/engineering teams to ensure our customers continue to grow successfully with Middesk.

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 3 days per week in our NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What You'll Do:  

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-market customers, ensuring they achieve ongoing value from Middesk.

  • Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers navigate challenges and optimize their use of Middesk.

  • Lead renewal conversations, proactively identifying risks and ensuring retention.

  • Partner with customers to increase adoption and engagement, helping them integrate new features or expand use cases.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to capture customer insights and influence product improvements.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience managing mid-market customers and driving retention, renewals, and engagement.

  • Strong relationship management skills, with the ability to engage both operational and executive stakeholders.

  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and support product adoption.

  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a focus on helping customers succeed.

Nice-To-Have:

  • Experience in financial services, risk management, or B2B compliance is a plus.

  • Bachelors Degree+

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About Middesk Engineering:

"Velocity" is the rate at which we effect realized value for our customers, not the rate at which we ship code. We believe that great products result when technical excellence and craft is combined with deep understanding of our customers and the problems we can help them solve. We're a humble, self-motivated team that seeks to ship early and ship often; we pride ourselves with being willing to roll up our sleeves to solve even the messiest problems our customers present to us. Middesk Engineering is customer-first engineering.

About The Role:

We’re looking for an engineer who wants real ownership early: someone independent, curious, and pragmatic, with strong systems instincts and good judgment.

You’ll work across reliability, security, automation, cost, developer experience, and internal platforms. A growing part of the role is building the systems underneath how AI is changing work at Middesk: the infrastructure that lets people and agents collaborate safely, ship faster, and operate with more leverage.

We don’t expect someone to have seen every tool before. We do expect them to learn quickly, care about the details, and take responsibility for systems that matter.

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2 days per week in our SF office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance of San Francisco — this role is built around close, in-person collaboration and mentorship with the team.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and scale cloud infrastructure and orchestration systems, including Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD, with support from senior engineers who are invested in your growth.

  • Own and evolve developer experience (DevEx) tools and workflows, from local development to deployment.

  • Build observability systems that provide insight into performance, reliability, and usage.

  • Improve the reliability of our production systems through safer deploys, automated rollback, failover, and platform hardening.

  • Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Platform and Product Engineers to build shared platform tools necessary to scale our products and services.

  • Help enforce and maintain security and compliance standards across infrastructure (SOC 2, FedRAMP, etc).

  • Drive a culture of automation, resiliency, and operational excellence.

  • Build the infrastructure underneath how AI is changing work at Middesk, including systems that let engineers, operators, and agents collaborate safely and effectively.

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer, with genuine interest in infrastructure, platform, or systems work – you don't need to have done this exact job before, but you need to want it.

  • Strong technical fundamentals: a deep, careful understanding of how systems actually work. This is work you can't vibe-code your way through.

  • A fast learner who is reliable, humble, and excited to absorb everything from experienced teammates.

  • Comfort with (or excitement about) work that isn't customer-facing – the impact here is deep, not loud.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, high-availability systems, production infrastructure, or infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g. Terraform) and GitOps workflows — none of this is required, you'll learn our stack here.

  • Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, automation systems, or AI-enabled engineering workflows.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or another environment where engineers own broad surfaces and learn quickly.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About the Role

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to help define the future of business identity.

At Middesk, you'll sell category-defining infrastructure that helps companies verify businesses, onboard customers faster, and manage risk with confidence. You'll partner with some of the most innovative fintechs, lenders, marketplaces, and B2B platforms, helping them build trust into critical customer workflows.

 

This is an opportunity to own strategic new-logo acquisition, work directly with executive stakeholders, and shape the growth of a rapidly expanding category. Every deal you close will have a meaningful impact on our customers, our product, and Middesk's trajectory.

 

We're looking for a consultative seller who thrives in complex environments, enjoys learning technical products, and is energized by building in an ambitious, fast-moving company.

We follow a hybrid work model with an expectation of 3 days per week in our NYC OR SF office.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close across enterprise and strategic accounts.

  • Build and manage relationships with product, engineering, compliance, risk, and executive stakeholders.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes focused on solving meaningful customer challenges.

  • Develop a deep understanding of Middesk's platform and partner closely with Solutions Engineering during evaluations and implementation planning.

  • Generate pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting, account planning, and relationship development.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer teams to share market feedback and influence our roadmap.

  • Represent Middesk as a trusted advisor and thought partner in identity, compliance, and risk infrastructure.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7 years of experience closing complex B2B software or infrastructure deals with multiple stakeholders.

  • A track record of winning new business and managing enterprise sales cycles.

  • Experience selling into fintech, financial services, B2B software, marketplaces, regulated industries, or similarly complex customer environments.

  • Ability to engage technical, operational, and executive audiences with confidence.

  • Strong curiosity and willingness to learn customer workflows, APIs, and technical concepts.

  • A proactive, ownership-oriented approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced environment.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling API-first products, developer tools, data products, or infrastructure software.

  • Experience working with fintech, compliance, identity, risk, KYC, or KYB solutions.

  • Previous startup or high-growth company experience.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product, and real customer problems.

You'll work directly with customers and internal teams to design, build, and deploy production-grade integrations and AI-driven systems. You'll own complex technical problems end-to-end, from understanding customer needs to shipping reliable systems in production. You'll also turn what you learn in the field into improvements that shape Middesk's product and engineering direction.

This role is ideal for a recovering founder, a former core engineer who misses direct customer impact, or someone who thrives on ownership and wants to build real systems where the feedback loop is immediate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and deploy real systems: Partner with customers to design, implement, and operate production-grade integrations using Middesk APIs, data pipelines, and AI workflows.

  • Own deployments end-to-end: Drive technical design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, making pragmatic trade-offs across speed, reliability, and scalability.

  • Build AI-powered workflows: Develop LLM- and agent-based systems, including evals, test harnesses, and feedback loops to measure and improve quality.

  • Solve ambiguous problems: Tackle complex customer challenges without established playbooks, working across backend systems, infrastructure, and tooling.

  • Shape the product: Turn customer learnings into reusable solutions, internal tooling, and product improvements that benefit the broader customer base.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping production software, with strong proficiency in either Python or Ruby and at least one other language (TypeScript, Go, etc.).

  • Experience designing and operating APIs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong debugging skills and comfort working across the stack, from backend systems to integrations and infrastructure.

  • Ability to independently own ambiguous technical problems and make sound architectural trade-offs.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating directly with customers and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience building or deploying LLM-powered applications, agents, or AI workflows, including familiarity with evals and common failure modes.

Nice-To-Have:

  • Former founder or early-stage startup engineer.

  • Experience in fintech, compliance, identity, risk, or fraud.

  • Experience building developer tools, workflow automation, or reliability and observability systems.

We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About The Role:

We’re building AI-driven applications that simplify customer workflows, starting with business onboarding. With our proprietary identity data and deep domain expertise, we’re in a strong position to expand into a broader set of intelligent, risk-aware products.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer to help build the foundation for these systems. This role is less about inventing new ML algorithms and more about applying the right techniques to messy, real-world problems. You’ve worked in fraud, risk, or trust domains, and you understand how bad actors behave, how data breaks, and how to still ship reliable systems anyway.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role with broad influence over how we design, build, and scale data-driven systems at Middesk.

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2 days per week in our SF/NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build fraud & risk systems
    Design and ship production systems that detect and prevent fraud across KYB, trust & safety, and compliance workflows.

  • Work with messy, real-world data
    Tackle problems with extreme class imbalance, sparse signals, evolving adversarial behavior, and limited ground truth.

  • Leverage relationships in data
    Apply graph-based approaches and entity resolution techniques to uncover hidden connections and improve risk detection.

  • Improve signal & labeling
    Use a mix of heuristics, weak supervision, and modern AI tools (including LLMs where appropriate) to generate better features and labels.

  • Help scale our infrastructure
    Partner with engineering to build and evolve systems for feature generation, model training, and production deployment across multiple use cases.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience in fraud, risk, or trust & safety
    You’ve worked on real-world fraud or abuse problems and understand the domain deeply.

  • Experience building and shipping production systems
    You’ve deployed models or data-driven systems that power external-facing products.

  • Strong foundation in applied ML or data systems
    Comfortable working on classification problems with real-world constraints like imbalanced data, sparse signals, and changing patterns.

  • Experience with graph or relational data approaches
    Familiarity with knowledge graphs, network analysis, or entity linking is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on and pragmatic
    You focus on impact over perfection and know how to balance speed, accuracy, and maintainability.

Ideally you have shipped external-facing models in the risk/fraud space and know the messy realities of imbalanced data, low labels, and changing behavior. We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2 days per week in our SF/NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What You'll Do:

  • Build risk & fraud ML applications: Deliver production ML models in fraud, trust & safety, KYB, and compliance domains, with measurable impact on customer workflows.

  • Tackle hard data problems: Work on classification problems with extreme class imbalance, sparse signals, and “cold start” label challenges.

  • Innovate in feature engineering & labeling: Use graph-based techniques, weak supervision, LLMs, and AI agents to improve signal extraction and automate labeling process.

  • Establish ML infrastructure foundations: Partner with the ML infra team to design feature services, model training pipeline, model serving standards, and orchestration to scale multiple ML use cases.

  • Design and implement knowledge graph solutions: Leveraging LLMs for graph construction, querying, and retrieval to enhance entity resolution and business identity use cases.

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of production ML experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Building Production ML for risk, fraud, credit, or trust & safety: Track record of shipping external-facing ML applications in one or more of these domains.

    • Knowledge graph applications: Hands-on experience building, querying, or extracting signals from knowledge graphs—ideally over business entity networks (companies, persons, addresses, relationships) to support identity verification, fraud detection, or risk decisioning.

    • Entity resolution for business or individual identities: Experience disambiguating and linking records across noisy, incomplete, or conflicting data sources—particularly in KYB, KYC, AML, or identity verification contexts where the same real-world entity may appear under different names, addresses, or tax IDs.

  • Expertise in classification with real-world ML challenges, for example: imbalanced labels, sparse signals, cold start, and production version management.

  • Hands-on ML infrastructure experience: feature stores, model management, ML training/serving pipelines.

  • Comfort as a senior IC: setting technical direction, mentoring peers, and establishing best practices.

Nice-To Have:

  • B2B SaaS experience, ideally building ML products for enterprise customers.

  • ML pipeline and automation engineering: Experience building end-to-end training harnesses that automate feature engineering, data validation, and model training.

  • Experience scaling ML across multiple products or risk domains.

Today, that includes:

  • Payroll Tax Registration Suite: Helping companies register, manage, and stay compliant with state payroll tax accounts throughout the full lifecycle.

  • Business Formations: Helping companies form new business entities and manage the workflows required to get them up and running.

Our flagship product, State Payroll Tax Registration, established Middesk as a critical infrastructure partner for payroll providers like Gusto, Rippling, and Deel, helping their customers hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant across the U.S.. The team is now building on that foundation in a few important ways: expanding beyond initial registration to support the full lifecycle of payroll tax account management, hardening and improving the platform to support its next horizon of scale, and bringing an entirely new Business Formations product suite to market.

You’ll be leading across products at very different stages of maturity. Some have meaningful scale and require continued investment in reliability, automation, operational efficiency, and platform capabilities. Others have only recently launched and require rapid iteration, customer discovery, and product-market fit work. Across the suite, we’re increasingly automating complex, multi-step compliance workflows through agentic systems that can act on behalf of our customers.

You’ll lead a small product team while staying close to the work yourself. You’ll help set priorities and coach PMs, while also owning the day-to-day execution of core parts of the roadmap. You’ll work directly with Engineering to shape requirements and ship on a fast, iterative cadence, talk with customers to validate problems and test solutions, and partner with leaders across Go-to-Market and Operations to grow these products through embedded partner distribution.

Location

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2-3 days per week in our NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead a small product team while staying hands-on. Coach PMs, set priorities, and personally own meaningful parts of the roadmap from discovery through launch.

  • Own the health of our flagship products, balancing reliability, efficiency, and new capabilities against metrics like SLA performance, retention, automation, and margins.

  • Harden Payroll Tax Registration for its next stage of scale, improving reliability, reducing manual work, and strengthening the platform underneath it.

  • Build and scale emerging products, including the broader payroll suite and Business Formations, from early launch through product-market fit.

  • Use agentic workflows to automate complex compliance work, designing systems that safely reduce manual effort and improve over time.

  • Stay close to customers and partners to identify problems, validate solutions, and shape the roadmap.

  • Expand into new jurisdictions, capabilities, and distribution channels to grow the reach of the product suite.

  • Support existing customers, helping resolve product issues and turning recurring pain points into product improvements.

  • Partner tightly across Engineering, Operations, Legal/Compliance, and Go-to-Market to turn complex requirements into products that ship.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5-7+ years of product management experience building and scaling B2B SaaS, automation, or complex workflow products.

  • Experience building B2B products delivered through APIs or embedded partner ecosystems.

  • A track record of owning products across different stages of maturity, from scaling established, revenue-generating products to developing and validating emerging product bets.

  • Experience managing and developing a small team, while remaining comfortable staying close to the work and executing directly when needed.

  • Strong systems and operational thinking, with an instinct for using metrics like completion rates, cost per action, automation rates, human intervention, and SLA performance to drive decisions.

  • Comfort operating cross-functionally across Engineering, Operations, Legal/Compliance, and Go-to-Market teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Domain expertise in compliance, regulatory operations, payroll, fintech, or legal tech, with the credibility to challenge existing processes and translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable product and automation workflows.

  • Experience operating in a high-growth startup environment, ideally at the Series B or C stage, with comfort moving quickly and iterating through ambiguity.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About the role

We're looking for a senior Partner Manager to own and grow a portfolio of Middesk's most strategic partners. These are fintech and B2B platforms (identity, risk, fraud and onboarding providers) that embed, resell or refer Middesk to their customers. Partnerships influence a meaningful share of Middesk's revenue, and this role is responsible for growing it.

You'll be the main owner of each partner relationship, from executive alignment through to the commercial terms and the day-to-day work of getting shared customers live. That means growing usage across partners' customer bases, running a real co-sell motion with our sales team, and structuring partnerships so both sides are invested in growing together. You'll join a small team and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering and Customer Success.

We follow a hybrid work model, and this role is expected in our SF or NYC office 3 days per week. Candidates should be within commuting distance.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners. You're accountable for both the revenue these partners drive and the health of each relationship. Be the primary owner across business, product and executive stakeholders, and keep each partnership multi-threaded so it keeps growing.

  • Build and run joint growth plans. Set revenue and usage targets with each partner, find the whitespace in their customer base, and turn it into a clear plan you track and report on.

  • Grow usage across shared customers. Work with Marketing and the partner's team on campaigns and enablement that get more of their customers live on Middesk and using more of our products.

  • Run the co-sell motion. Work with AEs and SEs on partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, following our co-selling rules of engagement, and help partners bring us into the right deals early.

  • Lead commercial conversations. Negotiate expansions, pricing and renewals. Sell the full value of Middesk, and structure gives-and-gets that reward growth on both sides.

  • Bring partner insight back to Middesk. Share what partners and their customers need with Product, and help shape roadmap and integration priorities.

  • Own and improve the partner playbook. Run account planning, QBRs, enablement and performance tracking, and improve them as the function scales.

About you

  • 5+ years in partnerships, account management, strategic sales or a similar customer-facing growth role, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another complex or regulated space.

  • A track record of growing revenue within existing partners or accounts, including expansions and renewals.

  • Strong commercial instincts. You can size an opportunity, build a business case, and negotiate terms that hold up.

  • Comfortable with technical, API-based products and with conversations involving partners' product and engineering teams.

  • Able to build influence across large organizations, with both executives and operators.

  • Data-driven. You use metrics to set priorities and hold yourself and partners accountable.

  • You enjoy owning outcomes end to end and building in a small team.

  • Nice to have: experience with KYB, KYC, fraud, risk or compliance products.

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

The Role

As the Head of Partnerships at Middesk, you will own and evolve our partnership function - a channel that today already directly or indirectly influences a third of Middesk’s revenue. Your mandate is to build on that strong foundation and take the function to the next level: a predictable, accelerating growth engine for the business.

You will lead a team working on two fronts. The first is deepening our largest reseller relationships, developing them from strong channel revenue engines into active demand-generation and co-selling partnerships. The second is building new partnership types, including SIs, referral partners, AI-native platforms, and adjacent verticals, to extend our reach into segments and use cases we don't serve today. You will also be responsible for embedding partner strategy across Middesk's go-to-market motion, ensuring partners are a considered input to territory planning, pipeline generation, product launches, and competitive deal strategy rather than a channel operating separately from Sales.

Partnerships is already material to how Middesk grows. This role decides how much more it can be. You will have executive sponsorship, an established partner base to build from, and real latitude to define what this function becomes at our next stage.

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 3 days per week in our SF/NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What You'll Do:

Turn our largest partnerships into growth engines

  • Convert our largest partners from resellers into genuine co-sell partners. Build joint account mapping and planning, shared deal visibility, and joint go-to-market motions so Middesk is at the table with the customer rather than behind the partner.

  • Convert existing partner goodwill into proactively sourced pipeline. Design the programs, incentives, and tracking that turn strong relationships into named-account referrals, not just resold channel revenue.

  • Grow integration breadth and enablement across our most strategic partnerships, covering new Middesk products and equipping partner sellers to lead on value rather than price, so Middesk is not treated as a commodity line item.

Build the next generation of partner types

  • Identify, prioritize, and stand up new partner types and verticals, including referral partners, AI-native and agentic platforms, and adjacent categories, to diversify our channel.

  • Build the enablement playbooks and onboarding motions that accelerate time to revenue.

Make partnerships a core part of how Middesk goes to market

  • Partner with Sales leadership and RevOps to define and enforce clear rules of engagement: co-selling, deal ownership, deal registration, credit and comp alignment, and escalation paths. The goal is to eliminate lane confusion and make Sales and Partnerships a coordinated engine on shared opportunities.

  • Make partners a considered input to territory planning, pipeline generation, product launches, and competitive deal strategy, so partner motion is part of the GTM plan rather than a parallel one.

  • Represent partner and channel needs in the product roadmap, particularly integration depth and the technical requirements of newer partner categories such as AI-native platforms.

Build the team and the operating foundation

  • Grow and develop the partnerships team, with clear ownership across existing-partner management and new-partnership development, and coach the career growth of the people on it.

  • Work with RevOps to build the systems and processes, from onboarding to enablement to reporting, that scale partner operations and give the business real visibility into channel performance.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years leading partnerships at a technology company, ideally with experience across multiple partner archetypes rather than a single model: embedded and platform partnerships, data partnerships, referral partnerships, and traditional reseller or systems-integrator relationships.

  • Direct experience in financial services or fintech, with established relationships across the partner ecosystem Middesk works in.

  • A track record of building a referral or co-sell motion from a low base, not just scaling one that already worked, including in emerging or unproven categories such as AI-native platforms.

  • Success managing complex, senior-level relationships with large enterprise and platform partners, and the negotiating skill to move a partner from a transactional reseller agreement to a joint go-to-market partnership.

  • Experience selling or partnering around technical, API-driven, or usage and data-licensing products, with enough technical fluency to engage partner product and engineering teams credibly on integration scope. Ability to leverage such relationships to successfully integrate new Middesk products into existing partnerships from both a product integration and GTM perspective.

  • A data-driven approach to prioritizing growth opportunities, including a clear point of view on how partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue should be measured differently.

  • Experience identifying and launching partnerships in emerging or unproven categories, and comfort operating in build-from-zero mode rather than only managing mature, established partnership types.

  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining partnerships talent at a growth-stage company.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

The Role

We have rapidly expanded our product suite, and the operational surface area needed to support it has grown with it. We are looking for a systems and process expert to help us scale our internal operations infrastructure gracefully and at a reasonable cost, while we maintain product quality and performance. That same person should be adept at taking things from concept to reality when the need for new products or procedures arises.

If you want to have a large impact on a growing product, and to work in a fast-paced environment, we would like to talk with you.

What You'll Do

  • Become an expert in the data that powers our products, and in everything it takes to keep that data accurate and recent.

  • Design, operate, and streamline high-volume fulfillment workflows that deliver successful client outcomes.

  • Automate recurring operational work so that it runs without manual intervention, and measure the time and cost that you remove.

  • Build the dashboards and analyses that show how our data and fulfillment processes perform, and use them to find the largest improvement opportunities.

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Sales, Product, and Customer Experience to launch new products, improve existing processes, and create multi-team procedures.

  • Partner with Finance to find operational inefficiencies and propose solutions that weigh financial and operational cost against benefit.

What We're Looking For

  • At least two years of experience in consulting, finance, strategy, or business operations.

  • Experience that shows you can design, scale, and maintain high-volume processes, with a focus on software-driven systems.

  • Experience that shows you can use data to find insights, drive action, and solve problems. We strongly prefer candidates who understand SQL and build dashboards.

  • The ability to use operational expertise to advise Product and Engineering teams on turning processes into internal and external products.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS startup or a financial services company.

  • Exposure to vendor management or to leading outsourced teams, or an interest in growing into that work.

  • Exposure to unit-cost tracking for operational and fulfillment processes.

  • Experience that automates manual work with scripting, workflow tools, or AI-assisted tooling.

Middesk is an equal opportunity employer; committed to a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

We are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If any accommodations are needed during the interview process, please let us know by contacting recruiting@middesk.com.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Enterprise
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

The Role

We’re looking for an Enterprise Solutions Engineer to own the technical win on Middesk’s largest and most complex opportunities: banks, large fintechs, payment platforms, lenders, and other regulated institutions where business verification sits in the critical path of onboarding, underwriting, or ongoing risk management.

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to the prospect: understanding their compliance program and risk appetite, their onboarding and decisioning architecture, and the vendors and internal systems Middesk will need to fit alongside or replace. You’ll design integration architectures that hold up at enterprise scale, lead technical diligence through security and vendor risk reviews, and build the business case for executive sponsors. Beyond individual deals, you’ll shape Middesk’s product direction by translating enterprise requirements and competitive intelligence into roadmap input, and you’ll strengthen the Solutions Engineering team through reusable assets and mentorship.

Reporting to the Director of Solutions Engineering, this is a highly visible role in a high-growth, execution-driven environment. We’re looking for someone equally comfortable whiteboarding resilient integration architecture with a bank’s engineering team, defending data quality results in front of a model risk reviewer, and presenting the business case to a Chief Compliance Officer.

What You’ll Do

Own the technical win on enterprise deals by partnering with Enterprise Account Executives across multi-month sales cycles. You’ll map the evaluation committee, build the technical close plan, remove objections, develop champions inside engineering and compliance, and keep the technical track aligned with the commercial one.

Design and run structured evaluations by scoping proofs of concept with defined success criteria, supporting large-scale data evaluations against the prospect’s own portfolio, and running competitive bake-offs against incumbent and challenger vendors. You’ll translate results into a clear, defensible case for Middesk and present it to the decision committee.

Design enterprise integration architectures that fit high-volume, regulated environments: real-time and batch patterns, event-driven and webhook flows, orchestration across multiple Middesk products, resilience and failover, monitoring, data retention and residency, environment strategy, and migration paths from incumbent providers. You’ll advise on how Middesk fits within the prospect’s broader onboarding and risk decisioning architecture.

Build the business case for executive sponsors by translating technical findings and evaluation results into the language of Chief Compliance Officers, Heads of Risk, CTOs, and steering committees.

Ensure a clean handoff to post-sales by documenting solution designs, technical commitments, contractual obligations, and the stakeholder map so Solutions Architecture and Implementation can take enterprise customers to production without surprises.

Champion the voice of the enterprise prospect internally by synthesizing requirements patterns, feature gaps, and competitive intelligence, and working with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to inform roadmap priorities and positioning.

Build enterprise capability across the Solutions Engineering team by creating reusable assets such as reference architectures, evaluation frameworks, and a security and diligence answer library, and by mentoring other SEs on enterprise deal execution.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years in a pre-sales or customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Solutions Consultant, or similar), including 3+ years working primarily on enterprise deals

  • Proven track record of technical wins with large financial institutions or regulated enterprises (banks, large fintechs, payment platforms, lenders, or insurers), with sales cycles of six months or more and evaluation committees spanning multiple functions

  • Experience selling or supporting B2B SaaS products with API-first or data-centric integrations at enterprise scale

  • Deep fluency with APIs, webhooks, data workflows, and SQL. You can read and debug integrations, explore and evaluate datasets, and design architecture credibly with a prospect’s engineering and architecture teams, including conversations about scale, latency, failover, and data handling

  • Experience leading formal proofs of concept and competitive bake-offs with defined success criteria, and defending results in front of technical and compliance reviewers

  • Experience owning large RFP responses, security reviews, and third-party risk management assessments for enterprise buyers

  • Working knowledge of KYB, CIP, BSA/AML, beneficial ownership, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring requirements, or a closely related compliance domain

  • Executive presence. You can present to C-level sponsors and steering committees, build a business case, and hold your position under scrutiny

  • Able to run a small number of complex, high-value deals in parallel with rigor, rather than a high volume of fast-moving cycles

  • Competitive problem solver with a bias toward action. You’re motivated by winning hard deals, resolving ambiguous requirements, and finding the path to yes

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at a business identity, KYB/KYC, fraud, or risk data vendor

  • Familiarity with bank third-party risk management, model risk management, and regulatory expectations for vendor due diligence

  • Experience with the onboarding, case management, or core platforms common at banks and large fintechs

  • Experience building enterprise sales enablement: reference architectures, evaluation frameworks, and repeatable technical sales processes

  • Willingness to travel for on-site workshops and executive meetings

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About Middesk Engineering:

We believe "velocity" is the rate at which we effect realized value for our customers, not the rate at which we ship code. And this pushes us to center our work around customers; how will this change I'm about to make help our customers get jobs done?

When we’re coding, we're making hundreds of micro-decisions about user experience that add up. How can I communicate this exception to our customers in a manner that helps them understand what's happened and unblock themselves?

About The Role:

We're hiring our first-ever Growth Engineer to join a small engineering pod that works directly with Marketing and GTM to bring more of the right customers to Middesk and help existing customers get more out of the platform. You'll ship features across the acquisition and expansion funnel - in-product trials, self-service onboarding, the middesk.com rebuild, expansion signal automation- instrument them, and use the results to decide what's next. Every project has a number attached to it.

What You'll Do:

  • Ship features in the Middesk dashboard that let customers discover and trial new products in context, such as trial credits, side-by-side proof points, and in-product case studies that show the lift a product would deliver on the customer's own data.

  • Build and improve self-service onboarding so that smaller businesses can sign up, get value, and convert without a sales touch.

  • Own the engineering behind the middesk.com rebuild: site structure, performance, content written for both humans and AI agents, hosted demo environments, and the testing infrastructure that lets Marketing iterate without an engineer in the loop.

  • Work day to day with Marketing, Sales, and Account Management to understand what they're seeing in the funnel and turn that into a prioritized backlog.

  • Apply Middesk's internal agents to growth problems: account and contact enrichment, content research, topic curation, and funnel analysis.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years shipping production web applications with strong full-stack fundamentals - we run Rails and React.

  • Deep comfort operating in ambiguous environments where assumptions and priorities change routinely.

  • Strong frontend skills and an eye for user-facing quality.

  • Comfort with SQL, analytics, and defining and defending a metric.

  • A track record of owning outcomes end to end, including measurement and iteration after launch.

  • Strong communication with Marketing, Sales, and other non-engineering partners.

  • Startup experience and a hands-on AI tooling workflow.

Nice-To-Have:

  • Prior growth engineering, product-led growth, or experimentation experience, including A/B testing frameworks and funnel analytics.

  • SEO or AI search (AEO) experience, or experience building marketing sites that serve as a real acquisition channel.

  • Fintech, compliance, or identity background where data accuracy matters.

  • Former founder or early-stage startup engineer.

This is a highly cross-functional role with exposure to every part of the company, from Product and Sales to Marketing, Operations, Finance, and People. You’ll move between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution, and the scope will evolve as the company’s priorities change.

We need someone who can get up to speed on anything quickly, turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, and see the work through to results.

What You’ll Do:

Drive high-impact special projects

  • Own strategic initiatives that cut across teams, taking them from ambiguous problems to measurable outcomes.

  • Step into the company’s highest-priority problems and opportunities wherever extra focus and momentum are needed.

  • Connect the dots across functions, surface opportunities and risks, and bring the right people together to move work forward.

Run the company operating system

  • Partner with the leadership team on quarterly planning, with clear priorities, owners, metrics, and accountability.

  • Run the company’s operating cadence, including leadership meetings, reviews, and performance tracking.

  • Own preparation of the quarterly board memo.

  • Track key decisions and commitments, flag risks early, and make sure work gets done.

  • Build lightweight processes and systems that help Middesk operate well as it scales.

Be a force multiplier for the CEO

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner, bringing independent perspective, sound judgment, and a willingness to challenge assumptions.

  • Represent the CEO in meetings and cross-functional discussions.

  • Own the details that keep the CEO effective, including calendar, weekly preparation, travel, and meeting follow-ups.

  • 4+ years of experience in management consulting, business operations, strategy, or a chief of staff role supporting senior executives.

  • A track record of owning cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous problem to measurable result, ideally in a fast-growing company.

  • Comfort operating without a playbook, and the ability to learn unfamiliar topics quickly and find a practical path forward.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to challenge ideas constructively and build credibility across functions and levels of seniority without formal authority.

  • Strong judgment and discretion, including knowing when to act, when to seek input, and when to escalate.

  • Excellent organization and attention to detail across many projects at once, holding a high standard even when moving fast.

  • A low-ego, high-ownership approach. You care about the outcome more than the credit, and no task is too small if it moves the work forward.

  • Based in New York and in the office at least three days a week.

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. The Role

Paid acquisition is being rebuilt by the same forces reshaping every other growth channel: real-time bidding, intent data, and AI-assisted creative testing are making it possible to run paid as a true demand engine with a defensible payback model, instead of a budget line an agency manages on your behalf. This role owns that engine at Middesk: the full paid channel mix across search, social, display, and placements, the agency relationship, the CAC and payback model behind every dollar spent, and the paid-specific landing experiences that convert it. You will own the qualified pipeline number paid spend produces end to end, deciding where to lean in, where to cut, and when to ask for more budget with evidence rather than instinct.

Hybrid

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role there is an expectation of 2-3 days per week in our NYC or SF office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What you'll do

  • Own Middesk's paid demand engine end to end: paid search, paid social, display/retargeting, intent and review-site placements, and sponsored content

  • Build a unified paid budget and channel mix, and manage the agency relationship as a vendor executing against your strategy, not as the strategy itself

  • Build a CAC and payback model by channel and segment that ties spend directly to qualified pipeline and revenue, not clicks, impressions, or MQLs

  • Run a test-and-kill system: a standing queue of channel, audience, and creative tests, with a cadence for reallocating budget toward what's working and cutting what isn't

  • Partner with EPD to build and iterate paid-specific landing pages and conversion tracking, distinct from the organic site experience but reporting into the same funnel instrumentation

  • Document the standard for which campaigns flex to support the Named Accounts motion (ads orchestrated around target accounts) and which run independently, and keep a shared calendar with that team

  • Build the case for scaling spend: real numbers proving the next dollar still pays back before asking for materially more budget

What we're looking for:

  • Senior IC role 5+ years of hands-on paid acquisition experience or demand gen marketing

  • A strategic thinker who can see the whole paid motion, channel mix, measurement, creative, and landing pages, and build one coordinated system rather than optimize a single channel in isolation

  • A track record of personally owning a number end to end in a high-growth environment, with real budget accountability, not just channel execution

  • Has run paid media across more than one channel at real budget, not just "a Google Ads person" or "a LinkedIn ads person"

  • Enough measurement discipline to defend a CAC and payback model to the CEO or CRO directly, and comfortable killing a channel that isn't working even when it's familiar

  • Enough technical fluency to hold an agency accountable, rather than rubber-stamp their recommendations

  • A strong executor as well as a strategist. You will set the plan and also do real work yourself: the briefs, the data, the model

  • A background like management consulting, or an early operating role at a high growth startup, is common but not required

  • Does not need to come from a narrow channel-specialist background. This role is about owning the whole paid system and the payback story that runs on it, not managing one channel at a distance from the numbers

Bonus points

  • Experience owning a paid acquisition budget end to end (not just execution) at a B2B SaaS or fintech company

  • Experience building CAC/payback models and defending them to executive stakeholders

  • Familiarity with modern paid platforms and measurement tooling, and a point of view on where AI can improve targeting, creative testing, or bidding
